narration: One in five Americans has an error on their credit report right now. Most have no idea it's there — and it's quietly costing them real money.
visual: Dark background. Giant '1 IN 5' text springs in. Below it, a credit report document SVG with three red X error marks appearing one by one on report lines.

narration: Errors creep in when creditors report wrong balances, accounts get mixed up, or paid debts stay marked unpaid. Nobody ever tells you when it happens.
visual: Light background. Three card rows slide in one by one — 'Wrong Balance', 'Account Mix-Up', 'Paid Debt Still Active' — each with a red icon and description.

narration: Here's the real cost. A 100-point score drop quietly adds $47,000 to a 30-year mortgage. That number isn't a typo — it's the math.
visual: Dark background. House SVG with a dollar counter animating from $0 up to $47,000. Label: 'Extra you pay on your mortgage.' Red warning badge at bottom.

narration: The fix is completely free. By law you get three free credit report checks every year at AnnualCreditReport.com. Most Americans use zero of them.
visual: Light background. Title '3 FREE checks every year'. Three calendar icons appear with checkmarks for JAN, MAY, SEP. Big green '100% FREE' badge bounces in.

narration: Find an error? Disputing it is free and fast. Bureaus legally have 30 days to respond — and your score can jump 50 points or more.
visual: Dark background. Person at computer SVG. Credit score bar animates from 620 up to 720. Green '30 days' badge. Tagline: 'Score can jump 50-100 points fast.'

narration: So here's your move: go to AnnualCreditReport.com, pull your free report, scan for anything off. Three minutes could save you forty-seven thousand dollars.
visual: Light background. Phone SVG with website on screen. Three numbered steps appear: 1) AnnualCreditReport.com, 2) Pull free report, 3) Scan for errors. Green CTA badge: 'Could save you $47,000'.
